blockingFindings: POSIX cancellation failures can emit the failed terminal before bounded process-group cleanup is confirmed: termination failure invokes onTerminationFailure immediately, while completeFailedReviewCancellation skips group confirmation when termination already failed. This can leave descendants unconfirmed and permits post-close child signalling.
missingNegativeTests: Inject a POSIX signal-error cancellation and verify cleanup observation precedes the single failed terminal, no post-close signalling occurs, and no review result is published.

architectureAssessment.deepModules: The launcher has clear routing, validation, process-control, and publication helpers, but cancellation failure needs one authoritative cleanup state machine.
architectureAssessment.hexagonalArchitecture: Repository, Git, child-process, and publication boundaries are separated; the cancellation failure adapter boundary is incomplete.
architectureAssessment.eventedBoundaries: Redacted progress and terminal events are explicit, but failure can be emitted before cleanup confirmation.
